welcomeLead: A self-hosted manager for your comic collection — track the series you want, download new issues as they release, and keep everything tagged and organized on disk.
welcomeSub: Setup takes about two minutes: where your comics live and optionally a download source — metadata works out of the box. Everything can be changed later in Settings.
bulletMetadataBody: Covers, credits and issue lists — built in, no API key needed.
bulletDownloadsBody: New issues grabbed as they release.
bulletOrganizedBody: Tagged and filed into a clean folder tree.
libraryLead: A library is a named collection with a type and a folder on disk. Create one to start — add more here or in Settings later. Files are organized into folder/Publisher/Title (Year).
libraryNote: Already have comics in these folders? After setup, use Import in the sidebar to match them to the metadata library and pull them into the collection. Leave a folder blank to decide later.
sourceLead: How should BackIssue download issues? Pick one to configure now — enable more or fine-tune later in Settings.
noSourceNote: No usenet or torrent setup? That's fine — plugins can add other download sources later from the Plugins page. You can still track series and import files you already have.
pluginsLead: BackIssue is modular — pick plugins to install now, or add them anytime from the Plugins page. Selected plugins activate when you finish.
noPlugins: No plugins available right now — you can add them later from the Plugins page.
readyLead: Your setup is complete. Here's what you configured:
readySub: Next: add a series with + Add (searches the metadata library), or pull in an existing library via Import in the sidebar.
installedRestarting: Plugins installed — restarting BackIssue to activate them…
allSet: You’re set up — add a series with “+ Add”, or import an existing library from the sidebar.
stepsFailed: Some setup steps failed — fix them and finish again, or skip: {list}
